relations.myth: Deborah commands Barak and sings YHWH’s victory
relations.note: Deborah transmits YHWH’s command, announces his aid, and praises his victory.

relations.myth: Jael fulfills the divinely foretold defeat of Sisera
relations.note: YHWH’s victory plan is indirectly fulfilled when Jael kills Sisera.

relations.myth: The song quotes the angel’s curse against Meroz
relations.note: Deborah’s song voice reports the angel’s curse upon Meroz for withholding aid.
Medieval Christian allegory casts Sisera as the devil and Jael as his vanquisher.
